about: Labelled pairs for the relevance floors (tools/memory.py RELEVANCE_FLOOR and FACT_FLOOR): a fact against a user's message, a note against a recall query, each in the form Steve embeds it. A hit is a pair whose stored text answers what was asked; a miss, one whose stored text is the nearest in topic and does not. Written before they were measured, about the fictional persona. Scores by python -m devtools.floors.
